coverEvidence.observed: The original cover explicitly identifies GENERAL STUDIES PAPER-I, Series A, 100 items and Hindi/English printing. It does not print an examination year. The matching key header identifies Civil Services (Preliminary) 2013, GS-I, Series A, 100 items and Nil dropped. The complete numbered question sequence and corresponding cells were compared; year/exam are not inferred from the downloaded filename alone.

The printed cover identifies GS Paper-I, Series A, 100 bilingual items. A handwritten CS(P) 2014 note is not the sole year evidence: the matching official key header explicitly identifies Civil Services (Preliminary) 2014, GS-I, Series A, 100 items and NIL dropped, and the complete first twelve questions were compared with it.

Printed cover identifies GENERAL STUDIES Paper-I, Series A and 100 bilingual items, with a Civil Services (Prelim) Exam-2015 stamp. The independently matching key header identifies Civil Services (Preliminary) Exam 2015, GS Paper-I, Series A, 100 items and NIL dropped. Q1-Q7 wording, displayed options and corresponding cells were compared; identity is not inferred from filename alone.

Both language covers show Series A, GS Paper-I and 100 bilingual questions; English cover PDF page 2 bears Civil Services (Prelim) Exam-2016. The matching independently headed key identifies CSE Preliminary 2016 GS-I Series A, 100 scoring items and NIL dropped. Opening English Q1-Q5 identities and options were compared, not inferred from filename.

Supplied cover identifies NDA & NA Examination (II), 2025, Series A, GAT, 150 items. Direct UPSC final key header and every Series A cell match the reviewed question sequence. Q58 accepts A/B; Q85 is X.

Original cover confirms NDA & NA (I), 2026 GAT Series A. Official UPSC-hosted four-page provisional key released 16 April 2026 has handwritten session I, printed Paper II meaning GAT, Series A, 150 scoring questions and zero dropped. Original wording and option order compared across all 150 numbers; source/key identity is not inferred from downloaded filenames.

Original cover explicitly identifies NDA & NA Examination (II), 2026, Series A, GAT, 150 items. Original English Part B begins at Q51 on page 9 and ends at Q150 on page 47. UPSC-hosted key header independently identifies NDA & NA-II-Exam-2026 (PROVISIONAL KEY), GAT, Series A, 150 total/scoring questions, zero dropped. Document hashes and complete Q51-Q150 cells were checked; identity is not inferred from the filename.
